# Konrad Kopczynski

> I help home services owners (1 to 10 locations) get more of their leads, quotes and past customers booked. It starts with a free booking check. Then Bea follows up the people the team doesn't get to. The owner approves every message and pays a flat $25 only when one books, up to a cap they set ($1,000 by default). No monthly fee, no percentages. It starts as a two-week test. Based in Kingston, NY.

## For home services owners

Start with a free booking check: send your website and I show you where leads and quotes are slipping without a follow-up.

Then Bea, the sales follow-up, works three lists:

- New leads and quote-quitters, answered fast, day or night.
- Quotes quiet 14+ days, and archived quotes the customer never declined.
- Past customers who haven't rebooked.

Messages go out from the owner's own system and phone line, only after the owner approves them. Bea works the leads, quotes and customers already in Jobber or another quote app.

Price: a flat $25 only when a customer books. The owner sets a cap ($1,000 by default) and nothing past it is billed. No monthly fee, no percentages. It starts as a two-week test, and the bill is the list of bookings with the record each came from.

## For PE home services platforms

- A free outside check of a target or your brands in 48 hours, with nobody contacted. Works as diligence on an acquisition target.
- Then a two-week full check, with permission, for $7,500, credited to whatever comes next.
- Then per-result pricing by brand, or Konrad as fractional head of AI ops.

## Background

I built Titan, an operating system for home services companies, used across 120+ home services locations in two franchise systems. In our own locations field labor went from 50% to 30% of revenue, cost per hire dropped 85 to 90% (from about $1,000 to $100 to $150) with a text screener, and close to 100% of invoices were collected. Before that I was VP Data & Intelligence at Croud, running a 43-person team and a $9M analytics P&L.
